messages:
sophie: Quick sync — we need final per-region inputs from hardware partners for the marketplace SKU pricing + the joint announcement checklist. Specifically: reserved commit windows (1/3/12/36 mo), spot eviction profiles, typical uptime guarantees, and any listing fee tiers. Can partners share CSV or a sample row by EOD? :calendar: 

ajay: tagging @coreweave and @zenith contacts in the partner channel. For the cost model we also need their preferred billing lag (30/45/60d) and whether credits apply on eviction.

maria: fyi — product wants SKU-level latency premium (ms) if available so the marketplace UI can show expected p99. Not required for the cost calc but helpful for sales docs.

ethan: to avoid back-and-forth, here's the CSV header we're expecting, pls paste one example row if you can:
```
partner,region,sku,commit_tiers_months,reserved_price_usd_per_gpu_hour,spot_price_usd_per_gpu_hour,avg_eviction_rate_pct,eviction_profile_notes,billing_lag_days,listing_fee_pct,latency_p99_ms,uptime_sla_pct
```

kai: example row from Zenith (requested permission to share):
```
Zenith,us-west-2,a100-80gb,"1;12;36",1.20,0.35,4.5,"higher during nightly maint windows (02:00-04:00 UTC)",45,1.5,42,99.5
```

partner-bot: CoreWeave uploaded supply_inputs_coreweave_q2.csv (link: https://s3.redwood.example/coreweave/supply_inputs_q2.csv) :white_check_mark:

ajay: thanks — i'll ingest that and run a quick delta vs our baseline. Any partners with combined reserved+spot bundling (e.g., guaranteed buffer) please flag — that changes blending in the cost model.

maria: small ask for partners: include minimum commit cliff (e.g., 30 days) and whether credits prorate on partial-month evictions. Helps legal/finance.

ethan: PR to cost-model repo will include a new shim to accept these columns. If partners provide multiple SKUs per region, send separate rows.

sophie: also: if a partner expects a joint announcement window (we're targeting mid-May), include blackout dates for promotional credits or co-marketing. We can't finalize marketplace listing until legal confirms fees.

kai: Zenith confirms no promotional blackout, but gives a 90-day co-marketing credit for signed commits > 12 months. Provided contact: partnerships+zenith@example.com

maria: one more — any partner that requires specific wording in the marketplace listing (e.g., "private tenancy") pls paste the exact clause. We need it for the announcement doc.

ajay: ingestion note: i'll normalize prices to USD/hr and populate a per-token cost estimate cell (rough) so pricing ops can run scenarios. Will post the PR link once done.

deploy-bot: file uploaded to infra-artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/partnerships/supply-ingest-2604044044.log

partner-bot: reminder: please avoid attaching large spreadsheets in channel; use partner-sftp or signed link.

sophie: perfect — thanks everyone. If possible, partners, pls try to get rows for both reserved and ephemeral SKUs (we need eviction distribution curves, but the example row above is sufficient if that's all you can share). Will compile and share model assumptions tomorrow. :speaker_high_volume:
